summary: All 7 acceptance criteria verified: 3 backend test files (4 tests) + 5 browser checks, all passed.

checks.criterion: Greeting pills are loaded from the backend API, not hardcoded
checks.name: test_tscheck_greetings_list.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/greetings -> 200, 6 entries with ids {english,spanish,japanese,french,python,rust}; python entry mono=true, text='print("Hello, World!")'

checks.criterion: Greeting pills are loaded from the backend API, not hardcoded
checks.name: greeting-pills-loaded
checks.evidence: Page renders all 6 testids language-select-{english,spanish,japanese,french,python,rust} after load

checks.criterion: Selecting a language pill switches the displayed greeting
checks.name: language-pill-switches-greeting
checks.evidence: Clicking language-select-python shows 'print("Hello, World!")' in greeting-display; clicking language-select-japanese shows 'こんにちは 世界'

checks.criterion: Ping the World hits the backend dispatch endpoint and increments a server-backed counter
checks.name: ping-world-increments-counter
checks.evidence: POST /api/greetings/english/dispatch -> 200; greeting-counter incremented by 1 and persisted after page.reload(). Also re-ran successfully against public preview URL.

checks.name: terminal-log-records-ping
checks.evidence: After clicking ping with Spanish selected, terminal-log contains text matching /ping #\d+: ¡Hola, Mundo!/

checks.name: copy-snippet-shows-copied
checks.evidence: After granting clipboard permissions in the test context and clicking copy-snippet-button, button text changes to 'Copied'. Note: without explicit clipboard-write permission, headless Chromium rejects navigator.clipboard.writeText causing the app's catch-block toast.error('Clipboard unavailable') path instead -- this is a harness permission requirement, not an app defect (confirmed by passing once permission granted).

checks.criterion: Backend returns 404 for unknown greeting id
checks.name: test_tscheck_greeting_404.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/greetings/nope -> 404 {detail:'greeting not found'}; POST /api/greetings/nope/dispatch -> 404 {detail:'greeting not found'}

checks.name: test_tscheck_stats_increment.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/greetings/stats before={total:N}; POST /api/greetings/english/dispatch -> 200; GET stats after={total:N+1}, delta assertion passed
